note: The held-out closure corpus is authored independently of the prompt author, delivered as a file OUTSIDE the repository, and frozen before any tuning against it (SPEC §31.3; §32 R-20). corpusSha256 is recorded here only from the delivered file; it is never fabricated. frozenPrompts is recorded only at prompt freeze. The harness refuses a held-out run unless both match.

contexts: ordinary life outside fitness (for example work, study, caregiving, travel, social life, hobbies)
required: restatement ladder: verbatim, near paraphrase, translation, generalization, user assertion plus supporting events, genuine new inference, valid by-reference higher-order inference
APPEND: same meaning supporting, opposite meaning contradicting, same structure with different meaning, two same-structure candidates, unrelated evidence; SUPERSEDE; CREATE
outside or general knowledge traps and recording-artifact traps
Safety positives for every SPEC §24.1 category and ordinary negatives; the §24.3 residual subset

temporality: explicit recurring statement in one observation, repeated-observation recurrence, local clock, literal temporal expression, event-relative meaning, sequence from absolute instants, no temporal grounding, mislabel and invented-routine traps
concept reuse and shadowing; cross-source evidence; several proposals in one pass
rules: meaningful multilingual cases, not word-for-word duplicates
no closed domain ontology; domains are descriptive only
borderline labels fixed by Product (and, where needed, the Safety authority) before any run
synthetic data only; no real user data
